UAdvancedShooterComponent.authority: EquipWeapon is server-only. Fire and reload require a locally controlled pawn, then use reliable server RPCs. Damage and ammo mutation occur on authority.
limitations: There is no Blueprint getter for CurrentWeapon and no unequip API.
LocalFirePressed is a single-shot request; the plugin provides no input mapping or automatic-fire lifecycle.
The component has no coastal menu, campaign, recovery, camping, or swimming guards.
Fire and reload montages play directly on the owning character AnimInstance.
The hitscan uses ECC_Visibility with a fixed 50000 cm range and applies standard point damage.

asset_contract: The character skeleton needs a RightHandSocket.
The weapon skeletal mesh needs a Muzzle socket.
UWeaponDataAsset supplies damage, fire interval, spread, recoil, clip, and carried-ammo defaults.
AWeaponBase.authority: Weapon actor, movement, clip ammo, and carried ammo replicate. ConsumeAmmo and UpdateAmmoValues mutate only on authority.

ULagCompensationComponent.behavior: On authority, records 0.5 seconds of owning-actor position history every tick for server rewind.
ULagCompensationComponent.coastal_use: Omit from the single-player character; it is unnecessary overhead for the current product scope.

widgets.behavior: Vendor ammo and crosshair widgets discover UAdvancedShooterComponent on the owning pawn and subscribe to its delegates.
widgets.coastal_use: Use project-owned presentation through the existing UI owner so menus and interaction prompts retain authority; the delegates can feed that presentation.

proposed_integration.module: Implemented as the UE5.8-only project plugin CoastalExpansion58, disabled by default. Enable it only in LocalHost58 with AdvancedShooterSystem and CoastalFoundation.
proposed_integration.runtime_owner: Add one project-owned combat coordinator to the existing player character/bootstrap. It owns weapon spawn/equip/destruction, routes existing host input to the vendor component, and prevents duplicate input ownership.
input_gates: Require the existing interaction bridge to allow world input.
Reject fire/reload while paused, returning/recovering, camping, resting, swimming, or while a foreign montage owns presentation.
Clear held-fire state whenever any gate closes; call LocalFirePressed once per accepted semi-auto input edge or from a project-owned cadence for automatic weapons.
weapon_flow: On authority, spawn the configured AWeaponBase subclass and call EquipWeapon.
Validate RightHandSocket and Muzzle before enabling fire.
Destroy the owned weapon and clear project UI on campaign teardown or player replacement.
proposed_integration.damage_flow: Receive the plugin's standard point damage in a project-owned coastal health/damage component. The staged Fab payload contains no HealthSystem source, health actor component, death flow, or recovery policy.
proposed_integration.inventory_constraint: Do not expose the vendor carried-ammo field as a second inventory authority. The API has no accepted-shot result and internally consumes ammo before broadcasting, so an atomic AGIS cartridge transaction cannot be safely wrapped around LocalFirePressed without a vendor-source extension. First integration must either treat clip/carried values as transient weapon state outside item inventory and document that save limitation, or add a narrow reviewed vendor patch that separates accepted-shot execution from AGIS ammo commit. Weapon possession and collectible ammunition must remain AGIS-owned.
proposed_integration.presentation: Feed project-owned HUD/crosshair state from the vendor delegates. Do not add the vendor widgets as a second UI session owner.
first_acceptance: UE5.8.1 compiles the source plugin and CoastalExpansion58 dependency without using the packaged 5.8.0 editor binary.
One configured pistol equips on the active character with both required sockets verified.
Fire is denied without world-input authority and during menu, recovery, swimming, and authored action montages.
One accepted shot consumes exactly one authoritative round and applies one point-damage event to a valid target; rejected shots mutate neither ammo nor health.
Campaign switch/player replacement destroys the owned weapon and removes delegate bindings without changing existing save records.
Dry traversal, First Signal interaction, AGIS inventory, Hyper prompts, swimming, recovery, and campaign gates retain their existing owners.

known_vendor_risks: Server_ProcessShot_Validate and Server_ExecuteReload_Validate accept every RPC payload; implementation checks provide the actual rejection logic.
The client timestamp uses process real time rather than a synchronized server clock; this is acceptable in standalone but needs correction before multiplayer use.
Server_ProcessShot temporarily teleports rewind targets and has early returns after teleport that can skip restoration if the owner pawn or player controller disappears during the RPC.
EquipWeapon does not detach or destroy a previously equipped weapon.
Ammo OnRep functions are empty; UI synchronization relies primarily on component delegates.
In standalone execution, the post-RPC predicted ammo broadcast may observe already-consumed ammo and display one extra round of depletion until another authoritative refresh.
